text:
maria (Product): Short sync: we need a concrete pilot and launch gating for long-term routing policies + tenant isolation. Goal: give enterprise customers residency guarantees and predictable p95s without ballooning costs.

sam (Eng-Platform): +1. Proposed pilot strategy: 8-week window testing 3 lanes: 1) soft-isolation (shared shards, residency tag preferred), 2) hard-residency (in-region-only, dedicated lanes), 3) consolidation (cross-tenant packing with cache affinity heuristics). Measure cost, latency, and capacity fragmentation.

li (Eng-Infra): Note: consolidation saves infra but raises eviction churn. We need fragmentation metric (wasted vGPU-minutes) and autoscaler rules that can coalesce shards. Also require per-tenant key-location validation.

aj (Eng-Architecture): Let's define crisp acceptance criteria before pilots: global p95, regional p95, regional p99 target, per-tenant cost delta, KV cache hit delta, and migration failure budget. Proposed: regional p95 < 250ms, regional p99 < 350ms, platform-wide cost uplift <= 10% for pilot, cache hit gain >= 12% for affinity variant.

nate (Solutions): Customers expect contractable SLOs. Two asks from pilot candidates: (A) EU-residency for keys and logs; (B) sub-300ms p95 for high-throughput tenants. Need to translate to pilot eligibility and opt-in language.

legal-bot (legal): Reminder: any residency offering must pass data processing addendum and make audit logs available. Legal review checkpoint required before enterprise pilots.

maria (Product): Operational gating: legal signoff, ops runbook, telemetry dashboard, billing attribution. Rollout gates: pass internal perf + two paid pilot tenants (one EU, one APAC or NA).

sam (Eng-Platform): Pilot rollout plan (high level):
1) Week A: internal traffic + fault injection (1wk)
2) Weeks B-C: two paid tenants at 2-5% traffic each (2wks)
3) Weeks D-E: broaden to 20% canary in target region (2wks)
4) Week F: decision window for gradual expansion.
Auto-rollback triggers: regional p95 regress > 20% vs baseline OR error-rate increase > 0.4% OR cost uplift > 20% org-level.

li (Eng-Infra): Telemetry checklist: route_policy, residency_tag, shard_id, cache_hit, eviction_rate, vGPU_util_pct, cost_per_request. Need a billing webhook for cost alerts.

aj (Eng-Architecture): Policy precedence proposal: jurisdiction constraint > customer residency opt-in > isolation lane selection (hard vs soft) > latency optimization > cost fallback. We should keep legal first, then explicit customer choices, then system optimizations.

maria (Product): Product decision: offer two enterprise tiers in pilot: "Residency" (contracted, higher price) and "Affinity" (improves latency and cache hit with minimal price delta). Include migration SLA in contract: we support automated cutover within X days if tenant opts in post-pilot.

nate (Solutions): For sales: need templated SOWs and pricing knobs. Also a migration questionnaire for tenants (peak QPS, allowed downtime, key residency needs). I'll draft.

sre-bot (bot): Runbook stub created: routing-pilot-runbook v0.1. Scheduled checks: daily perf digest, rollback window 30m after each expansion.

sam (Eng-Platform): Feature-flag sketch for rollout:
```
feature_flag: routing_pilot_v1
enable_for_tenants: [tenant_id_123, tenant_id_456]
weighting: {internal:100, pilot_tenants:5, regional_canary:20}
rollback_action: disable_flag
```

li (Eng-Infra): Ops must validate key residency: verify KMS key location and logs stored in region. Add automatic failure for tenants missing required residency-proof.

aj (Eng-Architecture): Migration tooling: we need a tenant cutover API that can pin a tenant to lane and perform cache warmup (prefetch common prefixes) and a dry-run mode to estimate cost. I can sketch API and idempotency model.

maria (Product): Success criteria for pilot: 1) both residency and affinity lanes meet locked thresholds; 2) migration tooling performs a dry-run with <5% error; 3) legal signs off and two paying tenants complete pilots. If only one lane passes, we productize that lane and document limitations.

sam (Eng-Platform): Next actions: I'll size infra delta and rollback automation by Wednesday.

li (Eng-Infra): I'll add autoscaler adjustments and fragmentation estimator. Also coordinate with billing to emit cost_per_tenant metric.

aj (Eng-Architecture): I'll produce the policy precedence matrix and cutover API sketch.

nate (Solutions): I'll identify two pilot customers and draft SOW + migration questionnaire.

maria (Product): Check-in Thursday for a short exec one-pager with clear go/no-go gates. Keep thread updates minimal. :rocket:
